title: 第9章 伺候公主洗澡第10章 阿青说我愿意
slug: 一剑惊天下可她身后的男人更可怕
content_zh:
君傲转过头，死死盯着阿三，眼神里带着警告：“不错，我刚才用的就是真气！”
阿三那张黝黑的脸上写满震惊，他结结巴巴地问：“世子，您、您不是没有丹田吗？这真气哪来的？”
“这是我的秘密，”君傲压低声音，“你不许告诉任何人，听见没有？”
“阿三明白！阿三明白！”阿三点头如捣蒜。
君傲眯起眼睛：“对了，你刚才看见什么了？”
阿三一愣，眼珠子转了转，突然一脸茫然：“我……我什么也没看见啊！对了世子，您一个人待在房里做什么呢？”
这话一出口，后面的阿青忍不住翻了个白眼……
她这么大个活人站在这儿，这阿三眼睛是瞎了不成？
君傲却满意地点点头：“很好，什么也没看见就对了。下去吧。”
阿三如蒙大赦，转身就跑，那速度比兔子还快。
“砰”的一声关上门，君傲搓着手转向阿青，脸上挂着坏笑：“咱们继续？”
阿青脸颊飞起两团红晕，声音细如蚊蚋：“世子，您轻点……”
“哈哈哈！”君傲大笑起来，正要伸手……
“吱呀”一声，门又被推开了。
“阿三，你丫是不是有病？！”君傲不耐烦地转过身。
门口站着的却不是阿三。
一袭鹅黄色宫裙的怀安公主正冷着脸站在那儿，月光把她整个人照得发亮。
君傲愣了愣，赶紧朝阿青的方向使了个眼色。
阿青会意，身形一晃就消失在了阴影里。
“公主，这么晚了，您怎么来了？”君傲挤出一个笑容。

怀安没接话，径直走进房间，在桌前一坐，“啪”地一拍桌子：“君傲，你什么意思？”
“我……我怎么了？”
“我屋里连个使唤丫鬟都没有！”怀安气得胸口起伏，“我想沐浴，连个烧水的人都找不着！刚才在院里叫了个丫鬟，人家直接白我一眼就走了……你们南王府的下人，都这么没规矩吗？！”
君傲一拍脑门：“哎哟，您瞧我这记性！实在对不住，这些下人平日被惯坏了，公主您多担待……”
“担待？”怀安冷笑，“我看你就是故意的！我好歹是你们南王府未来的女主人，你们就这么对我？”
“公主息怒，息怒！”君傲陪着笑，“我这就给您叫人去！”
他走到门口，扯着嗓子朝院里喊：“春杏！秋菊！都死哪儿去了？过来！”
过了好一会儿，两个丫鬟才慢悠悠从回廊那头晃过来。
走在前头的圆脸丫鬟手里还捏着半把瓜子，一边走一边磕。
“世子，什么事呀？”叫春杏的丫鬟拖长了调子问，眼睛却斜瞟着屋里的怀安。
“这位是怀安公主！”君傲板起脸，“公主需要沐浴，你们赶紧去备热水，好好伺候着。”
两个丫鬟互相看了一眼。
秋菊撇撇嘴，声音不大不小，刚好能让屋里听见：“哟，公主啊……看着就不好伺候。”
春杏接话：“就是，咱们笨手笨脚的，万一伺候不好，还不得挨骂？世子，您还是找别人吧。”
“你们……”君傲刚要发火。
“算了算了，”春杏摆摆手，“这公主还是世子您自己伺候吧，先走了啊世子。”
说完，两个丫鬟竟真的转身就走，边走边嘀嘀咕咕：“摆什么公主架子……”
“就是，还没过门呢……”
content_en:
Jun Ao turned his head and stared at Ah San with a warning in his eyes: "Yes, what I just used was true energy!"
Ah San's dark face was full of shock. He stammered and asked: "Your Majesty, don't you, don't you have a Dantian? Where does this true energy come from?"
"This is my secret," Jun Ao lowered his voice, "You are not allowed to tell anyone, do you hear me?"
"Ah San understands! Ah San understands!" Ah San nodded.
Jun Ao narrowed his eyes: "By the way, what did you see just now?"
Ah San was stunned, his eyes rolled, and he suddenly looked confused: "I...I didn't see anything! By the way, Your Majesty, what are you doing in your room alone?"
As soon as these words came out, Ah Qing behind him couldn't help but roll his eyes...
With a living person like her standing here, is this Ah San blind?
Jun Ao nodded with satisfaction: "Very good, you just didn't see anything. Go down."
Ah San, as if granted amnesty, turned around and ran away, faster than a rabbit.
Closing the door with a bang, Jun Ao rubbed his hands and turned to Ah Qing with a wicked smile on his face: "Shall we continue?"
There were two blushes on Ah Qing's cheeks, and his voice was as thin as a gnat: "Your Majesty, please be gentle..."
"Hahaha!" Jun Ao laughed and was about to reach out...
With a "squeak" sound, the door was pushed open again.
"Ah San, are you sick?!" Jun Ao turned around impatiently.
The person standing at the door was not Ah San.
Princess Huai'an, who was wearing a goose-yellow palace dress, was standing there with a cold face, the moonlight illuminating her whole body.
Jun Ao was stunned for a moment and quickly winked in Ah Qing's direction.
Ah Qing understood and disappeared into the shadows in a flash.
"Princess, it's so late, why are you here?" Jun Ao forced a smile.
Huai'an didn't answer, he walked straight into the room, sat down at the table, and slapped the table: "Jun Ao, what do you mean?"
"I...what's wrong with me?"
"I don't even have a maid in my house!" Huai'an's chest heaved with anger. "I want to take a bath, but I can't even find anyone to boil water! I just called a maid in the courtyard, but she just gave me a look and left... Are you servants of the Nanwang Mansion so unruly?!"
Jun Ao slapped his forehead: "Oh, look at my memory! I'm really sorry. These servants are spoiled. Princess, please bear with me..."
"Take care?" Huai'an sneered, "I think you did it on purpose! After all, I am the future mistress of your Nanwang Mansion, and you are treating me like this?"
"Princess, calm down, calm down!" Jun Ao smiled, "I'll call someone for you right now!"
He walked to the door and shouted into the courtyard at the top of his lungs: "Chun Xing! Qiu Ju! Where have they all died? Come here!"
After a while, the two maids came slowly from the other side of the corridor.
The round-faced maid who walked in front still held half a handful of melon seeds in her hand, cracking them as she walked.
"Your Majesty, what's going on?" the maid named Chun Xing asked in a protracted tone, but her eyes squinted at Huai'an in the room.
"This is Princess Huai'an!" Jun Ao said with a serious face, "The princess needs a bath. You hurry up and prepare hot water and take good care of her."
The two maids looked at each other.
Qiu Ju curled her lips and spoke in a moderate voice, just enough to be heard in the room: "Oh, princess...it seems difficult to take care of her."
Chun Xing answered: "That's right, we are clumsy. If we don't serve well, why should we be scolded? Your Majesty, you'd better find someone else."
"You..." Jun Ao was about to get angry.
"Forget it, forget it," Chun Xing waved her hand, "You should take care of this princess by yourself, Crown Prince. Let's go first."
After saying that, the two maids actually turned around and left, muttering as they walked: "Why are you acting like a princess..."
"That's right, I haven't gone through the door yet..."
